## USB Drive Inventory Collector 4.2.9

Workbook saves now use the Open XML SDK to package and validate the XLSX file before replacing the previous copy. The Windows build also creates a sample workbook, reads it back, and checks it with a separate spreadsheet reader.

The banner now holds Workbook Setup and Version Information beside a sound toggle. The record number column can be sorted. Duplicate notices use pulsing dark yellow text, and errors pulse red. Drive read results remain visible for at least three seconds before scanning moves on. Header text, status text, and their supporting lines have more space and consistent alignment.
